T: Run like the wind. Bake like your mum.
D: Two young sprinters from Western Australia sign up and head for Gallipoli.
P: Serve the biscuits when Archy and Frank meet at the athletics carnival.
S: Cairo market hummus and baba ganoush
Chickpea hummus and smoky eggplant dip, flatbread, dukkah, olives, cucumber

Hummus, baba ganoush and warm flatbread with dukkah, olives and cucumber, a dusting of paprika and plenty of olive oil. Blitz a drained tin of chickpeas with 3 tbsp tahini, lemon, garlic and iced water until silky. Char an eggplant over a flame, scoop and mash with tahini and lemon. Serve with warm flatbreads, dukkah, olives, cucumber, paprika and olive oil.
Egyptian fava bean falafel in flatbread with tahini sauce and pickles.

Soak 400g dried split fava beans (or chickpeas) overnight, drain and blitz with 1 onion, 4 garlic cloves, 1 bunch each of parsley and coriander, 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander and 1 tsp salt to a rough green paste. Rest 10 minutes, shape into 16 patties, shallow fry in 2cm of oil at 180C for 3 minutes a side until deep golden. Stuff 4 flatbreads with the ta'amiya, tahini sauce (4 tbsp tahini, juice of 1 lemon, 1 garlic clove, water to loosen), tomato and pickles.

M: Spiced lamb in flatbread, garlic yoghurt and sumac onions, on a night's leave before shipping out

Spiced lamb kofta grilled over high heat, wrapped in warm flatbread with garlic yoghurt, tomato and cucumber salad, pickled chilli and sumac onions. Mix 700g lamb mince with 1 grated onion, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp paprika, chopped parsley and salt. Shape onto 8 skewers and chill 30 minutes. Slice 1 red onion and toss with 1 tsp sumac. Mix 200g Greek yoghurt with 1 crushed garlic clove and lemon. Dice 2 tomatoes and 1 cucumber. Grill the kofta 8 to 10 minutes, turning. Wrap in 4 warm flatbreads with everything else.
Corned beef and onion hash with army biscuits
Tinned corned beef, potato and onion fried crisp, plain biscuits alongside.

Boil 800g diced potatoes for 8 minutes until just tender and drain well. Fry 2 sliced onions in 2 tbsp oil and 30g butter for 10 minutes until golden, add the potatoes and 2 x 300g tins of corned beef broken up with a fork, and press down. Cook over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning once, until crusty with a splash of Worcestershire sauce. Serve with fried eggs, mustard, and plain water crackers or hard plain biscuits.
W: Semolina cake soaked in lemon syrup, topped with an almond, with cream.

Mix 250g fine semolina, 100g desiccated coconut, 100g sugar, 1 tsp baking powder, 150g plain yoghurt and 120g melted butter into a thick batter and rest 10 minutes. Press into a greased 20cm square tin, cut into diamonds, press an almond into each and bake at 180C for 30 minutes until golden. Boil 250g sugar, 250ml water and the juice of half a lemon for 8 minutes, pour the cool syrup over the hot cake and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Crisp oat and coconut biscuits sweetened with golden syrup
Rolled oats, flour, coconut and sugar mixed with melted butter, golden syrup and bicarb dissolved in boiling water, rolled, flattened, baked at 160C for 15 minutes.
K: Strong black tea with condensed milk, poured into tin mugs.

Boil 1.2 litres of water, pour over 6 black tea bags in a large pot and steep for 5 minutes. Stir 4 tbsp sweetened condensed milk through the pot until dissolved and serve in tin mugs or sturdy enamel mugs.

steps.text: Mix the oats, flour, coconut and sugar in a bowl.
Melt the butter with the golden syrup, then stir in the bicarb dissolved in the boiling water.
Combine, roll into balls and flatten on lined trays.
Bake at 160C until golden.

steps.text: Char the eggplant over a flame until collapsed and blackened inside.
Blitz the drained chickpeas with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and iced water until silky.
Scoop out the eggplant flesh and mash with a little more tahini and lemon.
Warm the flatbreads and serve everything on a platter with dukkah, olives, sliced cucumber, paprika and olive oil.

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the onions in the oil and butter until golden.
Add the potatoes and corned beef, press down and cook, turning once, until crusty. Splash in the Worcestershire sauce.
Fry the eggs and serve on top with mustard and the biscuits.

veg.n: Potato, onion and baked bean hash with army biscuits (vegetarian)

steps.text: Boil the diced potatoes until just tender, then drain well.
Fry the onions in the oil and butter until golden.
Add the potatoes and cook, turning once, until crusty. Stir through the beans and sauce and heat through.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake up to 1 day ahead; syrup it while still warm

steps.text: Mix the semolina, coconut, 100g of the sugar, baking powder, yoghurt and melted butter to a thick batter and rest.
Press into a greased tin, cut into diamonds and press an almond into each.
Bake at 180C until golden.
Boil the remaining sugar, water and lemon juice into a syrup and cool a little.
Pour the syrup over the hot cake and rest, then serve with cream.
Boil the water and pour it over the tea bags in a large pot.
Steep for 5 minutes and stir in the condensed milk until dissolved.
Pour into mugs.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the beans the night before; the paste can be made 4 hours ahead and fried just before serving

ingredients.item: dried split fava beans, soaked overnight

steps.text: Drain the soaked beans and blitz with the onion, garlic, herbs, cumin, coriander and salt to a rough paste.
Rest the paste, then shape into 16 patties.
Shallow fry in 180C oil, 3 minutes a side, in two batches.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice, 1 crushed garlic clove and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Warm the flatbreads and fill with ta'amiya, sliced tomato, pickles and tahini sauce.
